answers.question: How many stimulus types have a percentage greater than 10%?
answers.reasoning: Three categories exceed 10%: Draft/Other (26.4%), Press Release (18.7%), and External News Article (18.1%).

answers.question: What is the average percentage of the categories that have a share greater than 10%?
answers.reasoning: The three categories above 10% are 26.4%, 18.7%, and 18.1%, summing to 63.2%. Their average is 63.2 / 3 ≈ 21.1%.

answers.question: Which category has a percentage closest to that of 'External News Article' but is still smaller?
answers.answer: No category is both closest and smaller; Press Release (18.7%) is the nearest value but is slightly larger than External News Article (18.1%).
answers.reasoning: External News Article is 18.1%. Press Release at 18.7% is only 0.6 percentage points away but is larger. The next-largest smaller category is Interview at 8.8%, which is much farther.

answers.question: Which two categories together account for more than 50% of the total distribution, and what is their combined percentage?
answers.answer: Draft/Other, Press Release, and External News Article together account for 63.2%; the top two alone (Draft/Other and Press Release) sum to 45.1%.
answers.reasoning: Draft/Other (26.4%) plus Press Release (18.7%) equals 45.1%, below half. Adding External News Article (18.1%) brings the total to 63.2%, exceeding 50%.
